review_prompt: Look for the same vendor, amount, invoice number, and payment date appearing more than once.
evidence_to_check: Invoice export, payment ledger, card statement, revised invoice notes
avoid_sharing_publicly: Client names, vendor names, invoice numbers, account IDs, contract text

review_prompt: List credits, refunds, or service credits that were issued but not matched to later invoices.
evidence_to_check: Credit memos, incident service credit notices, account balance screens
avoid_sharing_publicly: Confidential credits, account balances, internal owner names

review_prompt: Compare cancellation or downgrade records against later renewal charges.
evidence_to_check: Cancellation confirmation, renewal notice, signed quote, order form
avoid_sharing_publicly: Contract text, account IDs, employee names

review_prompt: Compare billed seats, modules, and service tiers against active use and approved changes.
evidence_to_check: Seat export, admin console counts, approved downgrade request
avoid_sharing_publicly: User lists, personal data, internal access logs

review_prompt: Check whether revised invoices duplicated taxes, shipping, processing fees, or manual adjustments.
evidence_to_check: Original invoice, corrected invoice, tax or fee line items
avoid_sharing_publicly: Tax IDs, bank data, invoice numbers
